title: Nourishing Silky Saudi Arabian Lamb Kebabs
description: A festive Saudi Arabian dish featuring lamb kebabs with a yeasty and silky texture, served with a spicy chilli sauce and a sweet glaze, suitable for satvik friendly diets.
instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together yogurt, lemon juice, garlic, ginger, salt, and black pepper.
Add the lamb cubes to the bowl and mix well to coat with the marinade.
Cover the bowl with plastic wrap and refrigerate for at least 2 hours or overnight.
Preheat a grill or grill pan to medium-high heat.
Thread the marinated lamb cubes onto skewers, leaving a small space between each cube.
Brush the grill or grill pan with olive oil to prevent sticking.
Grill the lamb kebabs for 8-10 minutes, turning occasionally, until cooked through.
In a small bowl, mix together chilli sauce and honey to make the glaze.
Brush the glaze over the lamb kebabs during the last minute of grilling.
Serve the lamb kebabs hot with additional chilli sauce on the side.
